title: The Two Lions
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Leo, feared in high school as the 'Demon Lion' and rumored to be a secret gang leader, moves to a distant university to escape his reputation as a misunderstood loner. Friendly, big-hearted Junpei, who went to the same high school, becomes his first friend and vows to help him make more, but Junpei's feelings grow beyond friendship. A single-volume boys' love romance.
life_message: Being seen for who you really are, past rumors and reputation, makes friendship and love possible.
